description: EVN publishes an annual-report series with editions including 2021, 2022–2023 and 2024–2025. The current provider page identifies the latest report and its PDF access route. The provider is Vietnam Electricity. Coverage: Coverage concerns Vietnam Electricity and the reporting years of each edition. This review did not establish which numerical indicators or spatial breakdowns the latest PDF contains. Access: The official series index and current report landing page were read. The web reader timed out on the linked PDF; no report was downloaded. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: Edition identity and the access link are verified, but indicator definitions, figures and completeness are not. No capacity or demand value is claimed from the unread PDF. For simulation the series is a source to consult for operator context and reported annual system information. Related resources: The series is separate from the Vietnamese techno-economic study and technology catalogue.
